summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest US movers.

• 6 upside misses — ANET +8%, WDC +7%, AVGO +6%, NTAP +6%, RMD +6%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (ORLY -6%, AZO -6%, STZ -5%, ARE -5%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: ANET (+7.61%) — Continued AI-networking momentum: BofA/Morgan Stanley/KeyBanc hiked PTs toward $190-$200 and BlackRock named it a top-30 AI stock after Arista's new 1.6T rack-scale AI switch launch. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe — ANET is a mega-cap ($170B+) networking-hardware name already up ~55% over the past year, likely excluded by market-cap/sector caps or an extended-valuation/RSI filter meant to avoid chasing fully-priced AI momentum names.

top_movers.catalyst: Continued AI-networking momentum: BofA/Morgan Stanley/KeyBanc hiked PTs toward $190-$200 and BlackRock named it a top-30 AI stock after Arista's new 1.6T rack-scale AI switch launch.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — ANET is a mega-cap ($170B+) networking-hardware name already up ~55% over the past year, likely excluded by market-cap/sector caps or an extended-valuation/RSI filter meant to avoid chasing fully-priced AI momentum names.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a mega-cap AI-infrastructure bucket (networking/semis, >$50B cap) to the momentum universe with a relaxed RSI ceiling when triggered by same-day sell-side PT hikes of >10%.

top_movers.catalyst: Continued AI-storage rally: fresh sell-side price target hikes (Cantor to $900, Melius to $1,050) on tight HDD supply/exabyte demand, plus Russell growth-index reclassification.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — WDC sits in the memory/storage-hardware sector, up ~115% YTD with extreme realized volatility, likely excluded by a sector or volatility-cap screen rather than a market-cap cutoff.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a sector-momentum override that pulls a name into the tradable universe once it clears an index-reclassification event (e.g., Russell growth add) combined with ≥3 analyst target hikes in a rolling 5-day window.

top_movers.catalyst: Broadcom expanded its custom AI/ASIC chip partnership with Apple through 2031, easing in-sourcing fears (Apple ~20% of revenue) and fueling a broad semis rebound.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — AVGO is a mega-cap semiconductor name typically excluded from smaller-cap or sector-specific universes; the move was a pre-market/overnight partnership announcement, so post-open news-reactive signals lagged the gap.
top_movers.suggestion: Add mega-cap AI-semiconductor names (AVGO, and peers) to the news-reactive strategy's universe with an earnings/deal-gate that releases positions on confirmed multi-year partnership or contract disclosures ≥3% pre-market gap.

top_movers.catalyst: Analysts hiked price targets (to ~$171.75) and NTAP was added to Russell defensive indices, extending the rally from its strong FY27 AI/storage-demand guidance issued at Q4 earnings.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — NTAP is a large-cap, low-beta enterprise storage/dividend name that likely doesn't clear the universe's tech-momentum or volatility screens, so it's never scanned regardless of today's move.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a periodic universe-refresh rule that pulls in large-cap tech names on Russell index-addition events or >2 consecutive analyst price-target upgrades, even if historical beta/volatility was previously too low to qualify.

top_movers.catalyst: Goldman Sachs added ResMed to its APAC Conviction List (Buy, bullish on CPAP patient growth) on top of building pre-earnings optimism ahead of Aug 6 FY26 Q4 results.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — RMD is a large-cap ($30B+) medtech/healthcare-equipment name, dual-listed NYSE/ASX; the bot's universes appear scoped to other sectors (e.g. tech/growth momentum names) and don't scan healthcare equipment.
top_movers.suggestion: Add GICS Healthcare Equipment (351020) large-caps ≥$20B mkt cap to the universe scanner so sell-side conviction-list adds and pre-earnings drift in medtech names get picked up.

top_movers.catalyst: Goldman Sachs hiked AMD price target to $640 (from $450) same-day as news that AI startup Turing is running ~10% of its training on AMD GPUs with AMD Ventures investing, pushing shares to a 52-week high.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — AMD is a mega-cap semiconductor already up ~154% YTD; likely excluded via a sector-concentration or correlation cap (redundant with existing NVDA/semis exposure) or a static/stale universe list never refreshed to add it.
top_movers.suggestion: Add AMD to the momentum strategy's tradable universe and replace the static sector-cap with a per-name correlation check so a second semis name is only excluded if correlation to an existing holding exceeds a set threshold (e.g. 0.85), not blanket sector dedup.

top_movers.catalyst: Bloomberg reported ORLY is preparing a $10B+ cash bid for Genuine Parts' NAPA auto-parts business, spooking investors on financing/integration/antitrust risk despite analyst buy ratings.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — ORLY is a large-cap consumer-discretionary/auto-parts retailer likely excluded by sector scope, not a liquidity or cap-size gap. This was acquirer-side M&A deal-risk speculation, a headline-driven repricing no technical/momentum filter would have flagged pre-move.
top_movers.suggestion: Add auto-parts/specialty-retail large-caps (ORLY, AZO, GPC) to the news-reactive strategy's tradable universe and add an M&A-rumor gate that flags acquirer tickers on >5% intraday moves tied to unconfirmed deal reports for next-day mean-reversion review.

top_movers.catalyst: Bloomberg reported O'Reilly's $10B+ bid for Genuine Parts' NAPA distribution arm, seen as a competitive threat to AutoZone; shares extended Monday's 6.4% plunge into today's session.
top_movers.miss_reason: AZO was tracked by macro-aligned/mean-reverter models through late June (predictions.jsonl) but fell out of every current universe at the last refresh; this M&A-driven sector move hit between refresh cycles, so no live filter saw it.
top_movers.suggestion: Add an event-driven universe override that re-admits recently-dropped names on a sector M&A headline + >5% single-day move, instead of waiting for the next periodic universe refresh.

top_movers.catalyst: Continued post-earnings slide: fresh analyst price-target cuts (UBS, Jefferies, Barclays) on soft beer demand/volume trends despite the June 30 EPS beat.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — STZ is a large-cap consumer staples/beverage name, a sector likely excluded from momentum/news-reactive universes tuned toward higher-beta tech/growth names.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a consumer-staples sleeve or widen sector filters to admit large-cap beverage/staples names showing multi-day post-earnings analyst downgrade clusters (≥3 price-target cuts within 5 sessions).

top_movers.catalyst: Multi-day slide extended: Mizuho cut PT to $60 (7/6) atop a Morgan Stanley downgrade to Underweight and Moody's debt-rating cut, all citing weak lab-space leasing/occupancy for life-science REITs.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — ARE is a life-sciences office REIT; momentum/news-reactive equity strategies typically exclude the REIT sector since price action is driven by rates, credit ratings, and dividend policy rather than the earnings/volume signals the bot screens for.
top_movers.suggestion: No actionable change — REIT exclusion is intentional given differing rate/credit sensitivity; if desired, add a narrow REIT sleeve gated on credit-rating-action and dividend-cut triggers rather than folding it into the existing momentum universe.
